text: The pharmaceutical and biomedical sector is one of the fastest growing industries in China and the rest of Asia. The demand for pharmaceutical and biomedical professionals with cross-cultural experience is tremendous. To help meet this demand, the College of Pharmacy at Nankai University is now offering an international Master program in Pharmaceutical Science. The Master of Science Program in Pharmaceutical Science is designed to take students armed with basic degrees in science and develop them to become pharmaceutical scientists, researchers, educators, managers, administrators and decision-makers in the private or public sector of the pharmaceutical and biomedical industry. Our program immerses our students in a cutting-edge, interdisciplinary learning environment with an emphasis on creativity and innovation. Our students acquire the type of biomedical expertise and scientific mastery that enable them to tackle the challenging problems faced by today’s professionals in the work arena. (Learn more of College of Pharmacy) Students are required to complete 13-15 credits of compulsory courses and 12-14 credits of elected courses from the following: 1) Compulsory courses: Chinese as Second Language (3 credits) Chinese Culture and Society (3 credits) Practical Medicinal Chemistry (3 credits) Computer Aided Drug Design (3 credits) Nature Product and Drug Discovery (3 credits) Process Development in Small Molecule Drugs (3 credits) 2) Elected courses Pharmaceutical English (3 credits, waived) Analytics in Pharmaceutical Science (3 credits) Translational Science (3 credits) Sugar and Drug Discovery (3 credits) Process Development of Therapeutical Biologics (3 credits) Target Discovery and Identification (3 credits) IP and Project Management (3 credits) Drug Discovery by Targeting Protease (3 credits)
